Description: Uncovered a GitHub Personal Access Token, potentially leading to unauthorized repository access and sensitive content exposure.
Author: kilo-cleanup
Message:
test(public): add public-surface leakage guard

Add a deterministic guard that fails if the tracked tree contains
the same classes of leaks the public-release audit found: real
RFC1918 LAN addresses, the homelab domain, homelab machine names
(bazzite, homelab-vm, transcode-host), private filesystem paths,
the operator's SSH user, private Gitea owners in URLs, the
operator's email, and the obvious private-key / GitHub / OpenAI /
AWS / Slack credential prefixes.

The guard ships as scripts/check_public_surface.py and a paired
test module at tests/test_public_surface.py. The test pins
behavior end-to-end: it must run clean on the tracked tree, it
must catch every representative leak class, and its allowlist
must not silently let real leaks through (RFC 5737 example IPs
and .example.test stay allowed).

In the same commit: remove the remaining private-environment
phrases that the guard flagged:
- 'bazzite' literal strings in tests/test_deploy.py and
  tests/test_doctor.py (the deploy-host constant is unchanged;
  only the test string is generalized)
- /var/home/rylee Fedora-Atomic footnote in ROADMAP.md
- homelab-dev reference in design/INTEGRATION.md
- gitea.example.com/rylee/vefr attribution URLs in the three
  worlds/lore/*/LICENSE.md files; they now point at the public
  GitHub repo
- gitea.example/rylee/vefr.git clone URL in docs/guides/install.md

The Storyteller WIP paths (src/vefr/{cli,generator}.py and the
20 untracked files listed in AGENTS.md 'Active checkout and
Storyteller WIP') are explicitly skipped by the guard with a
documented reason: those files carry private-host defaults that
the WIP team needs to resolve as part of the Storyteller-
architecture decision (homelab issue rylee/vefr#50), not the
public-release pass.

Verified by running:
- python3 scripts/check_public_surface.py -> 'clean (1332
  tracked files scanned)'
- uv run --group test pytest tests/test_public_surface.py -q
  -> 17 passed
